Never have my eyes seen your like, and I have suffered: long days the sea broke over me, and I know not one soul in this land. Pity a stranger — grant me some cast rag to wear, and show me the way to your town.

rows.t: Stranger, you seem neither base nor witless, and Zeus deals fortune as he wills — what he gives, a man must bear. But you have come to our land now, and you shall lack neither clothing nor anything owed a hard-tried suppliant. Stand, girls — this man is no enemy; wash him where the river gives shelter, and set food and oil beside him.

rows.t: Rise now, stranger, and follow while we cross the fields — but when we near the town, wait in Athena's grove of poplars until you judge we have reached my father's house, so no sailor's idle tongue can shame me. Then come into the city and ask for the palace of great-hearted Alcinous; walk straight through the hall and clasp the knees of my mother Arete first. Win her heart, and you may hope to look on your home and your own people again.
